articles.summary: -- Real-world data showed reductions in BMI with up to 18 months of setmelanotide therapy in 30 paediatric patients with acquired hypothalamic obesity (HO) in France – -- Phase 3 analyses demonstrated improvements across multiple cardiometabolic risk indices with setmelanotide in acquired HO --
articles.title: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals Announces New Data Presentations at the European Society for Paediatric Endocrinology Meeting
